In summary, our research is concerned with

the following aspects: - the design of a new self checking Reed Solomon (RS) encoder, which is able to detect and correct errors on the data and the syndrome; - the analysis of the effects of SEU faults on the RS encoder; - the comparison with the performances of the state of the art solutions; - the comparison between the performances obtained by the proposed architecture and the performances of an RS encoder implemented on a commercial FPGA.

the proposed architecture can be used in a variety of applications, from space to terrestrial systems, and it is suitable for the implementation of Reed Solomon encoders with different code rates and block sizes.
